sections.label: THINKING
sections.content:
The ghost at U3 is a fixed hollow green square (present from the start of the level, doesn't change with the contents of L3). In other words, this is a static hint: "N belongs at U3" — and the pipe is the means to get there.
Now, the decisive test: pipe mechanics. Currently L3=b. If I select b at L3 and click U3, does b flow up to U3? Or, if I place a piece at L3, does it automatically rise up?
Wait, actually — let me reconsider. When I placed N at L3 (the H1 test), the ghost remained hollow. If the pipe were automatically transferring the piece to U3, U3 should have shown a filled N. It didn't. So the pipe doesn't auto-transfer on placement.
Maybe the pipe transfers on SPACE? During the H1 test, SPACE didn't complete the level, and the ghost remained hollow. Hmm.
Or maybe the pipe is a swap channel: select a piece at L3, click U3 (or the ghost) → the piece moves to U3, and L3 becomes empty. Let me test: select b at L3 (36,34), click U3 (22,34).
No wait, before that: is U3 even a valid placement target in the first place? Earlier probe: selected R at U4, clicked U3 → rejected (no change, and the selection moved to…? At that time U3 was empty (ghost only), so the selection probably remained R or was cleared).
Let me test the pipe: select b at L3, click the ghost at U3 (22,34).

<parameter=code>
res = action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':36,'col':34}, {'action':'MOUSE','row':22,'col':34}])
def snap(f):
    d={}
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('R','N','Y','b','M','O','p') and n['pixels']<=16:
            r0=min(p[0] for p in n['boundary']); c0=min(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])
            pos='U' if r0<30 else 'L'
            col=(c0-21)//6+1
            d[f'{pos}{col}']=n['color']
    return d
print('after:', snap(current_frame))
a=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
print('U3:', [row[32:38] for row in a[20:26]])
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
